name: propositions
description: Author-claim infrastructure for academic LaTeX manuscripts: line-addressable propositions (JSONL), R1-R13 mechanical validator, audit chain (symbols / citations / code-manuscript / prop-iso), extraction discipline, and the domain-general manuscript-QA skills (clarity-audit, proofread, manuscript-audit). Supports propositions-ledger schema versions up to 1.6 (v1.2+/v1.4+/v1.6 rules applied conditionally, incl. multi-file \input manuscripts), plus verification records: a verification.jsonl sidecar with its validator and proofread-checklist conversion. Originally developed as the 'Locke project'.
